page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c24g1.24xlarge is an x86_64 GPU-accelerated server instance powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 processors. It features 96 physical cores running at 2.5 GHz with a single thread per core, supported by 372.0 GB of system memory, which equates to approximately 3.88 GB per core. The instance integrates four NVIDIA T4 GPUs based on the Turing architecture, providing a total of 64 GB of VRAM. It does not include local storage, relying instead on network-attached storage options, and delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 30 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks reveal a clear distinction between single-threaded and multi-threaded capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by stress-ng single-core and single-threaded compression tests. However, the 96 dedicated cores deliver strong multi-core performance, evidenced by high multi-threaded stress-ng and bzip3 decompression scores. Memory performance is robust, with cached read-only small block bandwidth reaching the top 25% of benchmarks, while uncached large-block read and write operations maintain average throughput. Redis SET operations also perform strongly, processing 64.27 million operations per second.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance offers a dense allocation of GPU and CPU resources, making it a viable option for parallelized workloads that do not require high-speed local NVMe storage. The absence of local storage represents a tradeoff, requiring network storage configurations for data-heavy operations. This server is well-suited for GPU-accelerated workloads such as machine learning inference, video transcoding, multi-threaded data processing, and high-throughput Redis caching layers.
